column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one arm per dialect, each calling testutil.TestDB, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs (the cluster job runs ./engine/... too) while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name rather than by delta, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset: go test ./engine/ -run TestACompletedIntentStoresNullNotEmptyOnEveryDialect -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly the mysql and mssql arms. The arms have to exist even where they skip: the raw response bind cleat#1379 fixed was in all SIX call-intent statements, two per dialect, and leaving two dialects storing '' where PostgreSQL stores NULL is the same divergence the other half of that issue was about.
